item.title: momo 1.6
item.description:
Locked folders

  • Right-click a folder and choose Lock Folder… to lock every note in it, with your locked-notes password.
  • A locked folder opens with one tap of Touch ID or your password, and locks again when you leave it, choose Lock Now, or your Mac sleeps.
  • Notes you add or move into a locked folder are locked too. Remove Lock… unlocks them all.

Fixes

  • A new note no longer turns into an empty "Untitled" and a conflict copy when iCloud is slow to answer.
